Definition: middle voice from G1909 and G450; to stand up on, i.e. (figuratively) to attack:--rise up against.
BiblicalUsage: To rise up against — children against parents, brother against brother. Jesus says children shall rise up against their parents and cause them to be put to death in Mark 13:12 and Matthew 10:21, when brother betrays brother for His name's sake.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gospel divides even families, and the rising up Jesus foretold is the cost of following Him when those nearest to us will not.
